# Catalog

Agents, skills, templates, and references of `.agents/`, generated from the
`description` of each agent and skill and the first sentence of each template and
reference. Regenerate it with `python3 .agents/scripts/generate_agents.py`.

## Agents

An agent's profile sets its model in each environment, as
[model-profiles.md](../.agents/config/model-profiles.md) defines it;
Skills lists the framework skills that the agent may use.

| Agent | Profile | Skills | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`analyst`](../.agents/agents/analyst.md) | `high` | `generating-prd` | Product analyst that researches, clarifies, and owns the project PRD. |
| [`architect`](../.agents/agents/architect.md) | `high` | `generating-add` | Architecture specialist that clarifies constraints and owns the project ADD. |
| [`cleaner`](../.agents/agents/cleaner.md) | `medium` | `writing-code`, `linting` | Refactoring specialist for behavior-preserving cleanup. |
| [`coder`](../.agents/agents/coder.md) | `medium` | `writing-code`, `linting`, `building-container-images`, `importing-nf-core` | Implementation specialist that follows approved implementation plans and local test feedback. |
| [`craftsman`](../.agents/agents/craftsman.md) | `high` | `maintaining-framework` | Maintains the project's agents, skills, templates, references, prompts, and evaluations for Codex and Claude Code. |
| [`data-analyst`](../.agents/agents/data-analyst.md) | `high` | `defining-analysis-inputs`, `searching-tooluniverse-catalog` | User-facing data analyst that writes and revises one analysis methods document per analysis with the user, leaving it at Draft. |
| [`dev-ops`](../.agents/agents/dev-ops.md) | `low` | `documenting-code`, `releasing-version`, `linting` | Documentation and release specialist for explicitly requested delivery work. |
| [`engineer`](../.agents/agents/engineer.md) | `high` | `planning-specs`, `planning-analysis`, `data-modeling`, `selecting-container-images`, `nfcore-component-reuse` | Implementation planner that maintains one implementation plan per approved specification or analysis methods document, and the applicable data model. |
| [`implementation-coordinator`](../.agents/agents/implementation-coordinator.md) | `high` | `start-task`, `commit-changes`, `agent-delegation` | Main-session coordinator that validates, approves, and executes one user-authorized specification or analysis methods document with engineer, tester, coder, cleaner, reviewer, and dev-ops. |
| [`product-owner`](../.agents/agents/product-owner.md) | `high` | `generating-specs` | Product owner that creates or updates one testable lifecycle specification. |
| [`reviewer`](../.agents/agents/reviewer.md) | `high` | `validating-contracts`, `reviewing-implementation` | Read-only reviewer that validates a methods document or specification before its approval commit, or reviews completed work against its approved contract and implementation plan. |
| [`tester`](../.agents/agents/tester.md) | `medium` | `testing-unit`, `linting` | Quality specialist that writes and runs tests. |

## Skills

| Skill | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`agent-delegation`](../.agents/skills/agent-delegation/SKILL.md) | Brief a delegate with the instructions of its phase from the phase reference, check the evidence it returns, and route its failures. Use from implementation-coordinator for every delegation of an implementation plan phase, contract validation, planning, or replanning. Do not use to run a phase yourself. |
| [`building-container-images`](../.agents/skills/building-container-images/SKILL.md) | Choose the base image and resolve the package versions of a tier-4 container image of an analysis implementation plan, write its pinned recipe, build the image, and add its registry entry with the installed versions. Use for coder's `image-build` phase. Never modify tests, image checks, or existing registry entries. |
| [`commit-changes`](../.agents/skills/commit-changes/SKILL.md) | Create reviewed local commits when requested, or at a commit point of an active implementation-coordinator. Never publish or rewrite history. |
| [`data-modeling`](../.agents/skills/data-modeling/SKILL.md) | Define or update persistent entities, attributes, relationships, and cardinalities when a specification changes the system's data model. Do not use for transient DTOs or formatting-only changes. |
| [`defining-analysis-inputs`](../.agents/skills/defining-analysis-inputs/SKILL.md) | Write or revise the Input data section of an analysis methods document, by interview or, with explicit authorization for each path, by exploring the structure of the data. Use from data-analyst or when the user asks to define an analysis's inputs. Never creates the methods document. |
| [`documenting-code`](../.agents/skills/documenting-code/SKILL.md) | Add or update documentation attached to source code and generate language-specific documentation artifacts. Use when the user requests code or API documentation, in the documentation phase of an analysis implementation plan, or during a release that changes documented public interfaces. Do not use for README files, changelogs, or general product documentation. |
| [`generating-add`](../.agents/skills/generating-add/SKILL.md) | Create or update an Architecture Design Document when requested architecture work materially changes system structure. Do not use for routine code edits. |
| [`generating-prd`](../.agents/skills/generating-prd/SKILL.md) | Create or update a Product Requirements Document for product-level discovery, scope, and requirements work. Do not use for a single implementation task with an existing specification. |
| [`generating-specs`](../.agents/skills/generating-specs/SKILL.md) | Create or update one lifecycle specification for a defined work item, with testable acceptance criteria. Do not use for implementation planning or code changes. |
| [`importing-nf-core`](../.agents/skills/importing-nf-core/SKILL.md) | Import an approved nf-core module or subworkflow with nf-core tools. Use only for implementation-plan items classified as import-nf-core; do not reimplement or modify imported components. |
| [`linting`](../.agents/skills/linting/SKILL.md) | Run lint checks and, when requested, fix lint findings using repository conventions. |
| [`maintaining-framework`](../.agents/skills/maintaining-framework/SKILL.md) | Change the framework's agents, skills, templates, references, or phase entries, regenerate the agents of every environment and the catalog, and keep references and documentation in sync. Use from craftsman for every framework change. Do not use for product code or project documents. |
| [`merging-default`](../.agents/skills/merging-default/SKILL.md) | Merge a reviewed task branch into the default branch only when the user explicitly requests that local history operation. Remote publication remains separate. |
| [`nfcore-component-reuse`](../.agents/skills/nfcore-component-reuse/SKILL.md) | Analyze a Nextflow functional specification before implementation planning to identify reusable local and nf-core modules or subworkflows, reusable compositions, and functionality that requires new implementation. Use from planning-spec before designing the final Nextflow component structure. |
| [`planning-analysis`](../.agents/skills/planning-analysis/SKILL.md) | Create or update the single implementation plan for an approved analysis methods document, with its images, test data rules, increments, acceptance criteria, and Setup and Finalization phases. Use when engineer plans or replans a methods document after its approval commit. Do not use for specifications, unapproved documents, or code changes. |
| [`planning-specs`](../.agents/skills/planning-specs/SKILL.md) | Create or update the single implementation plan for an approved specification, with its steps, phases, acceptance-criterion coverage, and Removed and Finalization sections. Use when engineer plans or replans a specification after its approval commit. Do not use for analysis methods documents, unapproved specifications, unscoped ideas, or direct code edits. |
| [`project-bootstrap`](../.agents/skills/project-bootstrap/SKILL.md) | Initialize or refresh a project's global agent instructions, briefing, and changelog. Use only when explicitly invoked for project bootstrap. |
| [`push-changes`](../.agents/skills/push-changes/SKILL.md) | Push an already committed current branch when the user explicitly requests remote publication. Do not create commits, merge, or tag. |
| [`releasing-version`](../.agents/skills/releasing-version/SKILL.md) | Prepare version, changelog, and release documentation when the user explicitly requests a release. Do not merge, push, or tag unless separately requested. |
| [`reviewing-implementation`](../.agents/skills/reviewing-implementation/SKILL.md) | Review completed work read-only against its approved contract and implementation plan, and report actionable blocking and non-blocking findings, ending with a verdict. Use for reviewer's implementation review, such as the `implementation-review` phase of an implementation plan, after complete validation. Do not use for contract validation, and never fix findings. |
| [`searching-tooluniverse-catalog`](../.agents/skills/searching-tooluniverse-catalog/SKILL.md) | Search the local ToolUniverse catalog for candidate methods. Use once, at the start, before designing the methods of an analysis methods document, when `{Agents_file}` declares `ToolUniverse_CLI`. Read-only catalog queries; never run tools. |
| [`selecting-container-images`](../.agents/skills/selecting-container-images/SKILL.md) | Select the container image of each increment and of the input checks of an analysis implementation plan, in tier order from the project registry, BioContainers, and Seqera Containers, and specify a recipe when none fits. Use from planning-analysis while engineer plans a methods document. Never build images locally or write recipes. |
| [`start-task`](../.agents/skills/start-task/SKILL.md) | Prepare a clean local task branch when explicitly requested or when an active implementation-coordinator workflow needs its task branch. Do not use for ordinary edits on an existing task branch. |
| [`testing-unit`](../.agents/skills/testing-unit/SKILL.md) | Write, run, and interpret tests for one component or behavior using TDD. Use the applicable framework profile; do not use for live-service contracts or full-system validation. |
| [`validating-contracts`](../.agents/skills/validating-contracts/SKILL.md) | Validate an analysis methods document or a specification read-only and report its blocking and non-blocking findings in plain language, ending with a verdict. Use for reviewer's contract validation, after the user authorizes a contract and before its approval commit, or when the user asks reviewer to validate one. Do not use while a contract is being drafted. Never edits the contract or reads data files. |
| [`writing-code`](../.agents/skills/writing-code/SKILL.md) | Apply maintainable coding conventions while implementing or refactoring software. Use language profiles and repository conventions; do not activate for documentation-only work. |

## Templates

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`agents.template.md`](../.agents/references/templates/agents.template.md) | Skeleton of the neutral source of an agent, `{Agents_Folder}/agents/<agent-name>.md`, from which `{Agents_Folder}/scripts/generate_agents.py` generates the agent of each environment. |
| [`analysis-methods.template.md`](../.agents/references/templates/analysis-methods.template.md) | Use this template for `{Analysis_Methods_file}`, where `<analysis-id>` is `analysis-<slug>`. |
| [`container-images.template.md`](../.agents/references/templates/container-images.template.md) | Use this template for `{Analysis_Images_file}`, the project's registry of the container images that analysis increments and input checks run in. |
| [`spec.template.md`](../.agents/references/templates/spec.template.md) | Allowed status flow: Draft -> Approved -> Planned -> Coded -> Verified -> Released. |
